name: Hildyr
source:
Hildyr was the leader of the witches and bearer of the Crystallum Tenebrarum during the Great War. She was corrupted by the Tenebrarum and started the Great War in retaliation for the murder of witches during the Witch Hunt. Hildyr created the Fairytale Curse immediately prior to losing the Great War.
[spoiler]Hildyr killed the previous king and forced Genaro to marry her and later rapes him. She is the mother of Lucette and has raised her to be heartless to prepare her to be her successor.
[/spoiler]
